name: Igni
description: Ember-skinned people of Caldera's volcanic south, with cracks of molten light in their skin. They are cousins of the wyrmkin, not dragon-blooded themselves.

name: Human
description: You are ok sometimes

name: Quillary
description: Hedgehog-like small folk with spines down their backs. They are stubborn burrowers who are very hard to grab.

name: Dross
description: Blue-gray coastal people of Atheria's shores, with webbed hands and gill marks. They are sailors and traders by trade.

name: Radiant
description: Folk born with starlight in their blood. Seams of living gold light run beneath their skin like veins of ore, and the light flares brighter with emotion. Eldridian lore says the first Radiants were born where falling stars struck the earth. They have no wings; their gift is inner light. They are warm, steady protectors who see it as their duty to stand where the dark is deepest.

name: Dwarf
description: You have an affinity for tools, and grew up at sea.

name: Ouros
description: You have a draconic appearance, and the ability to breath fire

name: Ent
description: Folk grown from the roots of the Tree of Life. Bark-skinned, with leaves for hair, they are slow, patient, and hard to move.

name: Dawn Elf
description: You have bright green eyes, and attunement to nature.

name: Vespar
description: Pale-blue folk with storm-white hair that is never still, even when the air is calm. They are said to be children of the high winds above Eldridia's clouds, carried down to the world on the first storm. Skyborn are wingless; the wind itself lifts them. Cheerful, restless wanderers and rescuers, they believe no one should ever be left behind.

name: Morvyne
description: Raven-feathered humanoids who carry messages, trade in secrets, and are said to keep watch over the dead.

name: Gemine
description: Tall, slow mountain folk who look carved from living granite. They live for centuries and forget nothing.

name: Vantus
description: Survivors of Hollow exposure. Gaunt, with pale gray eyes and patches of their bodies gone hollow, they carry something empty inside them that the living find unsettling.

name: Lumen
description: Slender butterfly fae with large, brilliant wings whose patterns are unique to each one, like a fingerprint. Unlike the moth-winged Wyrdlings of the ruins, Lumenwings are sunlit folk of flowering groves: dazzling, flighty, and drawn to color and life.

name: Uron
description: You have large claws, and a bear like appearance

name: Orc
description: Orcs came to Lys under King Barathos, when the kindest of the Alterian kings opened the realm's borders. They came as workers, soldiers, and settlers, and many earned their place the hard way, through the Second Great War and the long Civil Wars that followed. Strong, broad, and hard to kill, orcs are known in Lys for loyalty to whoever treats them fairly, and long memories for whoever doesn't. Where they came from before Lys is a story each clan tells differently.

name: Morrow Elf
description: You have bright red eyes, pale to dark skin, and have an affinity for mountainous terrain

name: Wyrdling
description: Small, moth-winged fae folk with glowing eyes. They drift around ruins and old magic.

name: Gehennan
description: People born with devil blood, each bloodline believed to descend from a devil house of Gehenna. Glowing grooves mark their skin, and their irises share the color of the dark magic in their veins: red, purple, gold, or orange. They do not age and die only if struck down. Atheria's paladins persecute them on sight.

name: Lupine
description: Loyal dog folk who live in packs, with looks that follow their breed lines. A Lupine might be a sturdy mastiff, a lean greyhound, a fluffy husky, a powerful rottweiler, a shepherd, or a hound.

name: Vellari
description: Fox folk of the Wildlands with two to five tails, quick, curious, and natural trackers. Each Vellari is born into one of eight gem lines, which sets their fur color: Opal (white, the classic look), Onyx (black), Amethyst (purple), Topaz (orange), Quartz (clear crystal), Emerald (green), Ruby (red), or Sapphire (blue).

name: Halfling
description: You are known for being able to fit into small spaces, and have an affinity for slight of hand

name: Dusk Elf
description: Elves of Sable, the primordial dragon of death. Black-skinned with bright purple-to-indigo eyes and a faint spectral shimmer, they walk calmly at the edge between life and its ending.

name: Homunculi
description: Artificial souls created by alchemists seeking immortality. Most are considered failed experiments and treated poorly, but some are treated as family. Their skin is ivory and porcelain-like, ringed with fine gold seams at the wrists, elbows and shoulders, and their soul is a sentient glossy black liquid that drifts around them in ribbons and droplets. They are rare, and most can blend into normal society. Languages: Trade plus one language of the player's choice.

name: Dusk-veined
description: Purple veins, Purple Magic (Weaken). Resistance to psychic damage. Veinfire deals psychic; the target has disadvantage on its next save against you.

name: Oathveined
description: Gold veins, Yellow Magic (Strengthen). Resistance to force damage. Veinfire deals force; you gain temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Rustveined
description: Orange veins, Orange Magic (Hinder). Resistance to acid damage. Veinfire deals acid; the target's speed drops by 10 ft.

name: Wrathveined
description: Red veins, Red Magic (Offense). Resistance to fire damage. Veinfire deals fire; the target takes 1d4 fire at the start of its next turn.

name: Bloodhound
description: A keen-nosed hound. Track by scent across a trail up to a day old.

name: Greyhound
description: A lean, fast breed. +10 ft speed.

name: Husky
description: A fluffy breed from the cold. Resistance to cold damage.

name: Mastiff
description: A sturdy, heavy-set breed. +1 HP per level.

name: Rottweiler
description: A powerful breed. Bite: 1d6 + Might as a bonus action, 1 per short rest.

name: Shepherd
description: A watchful herding breed. +2 Awareness.

name: Amethyst
description: Purple fur. Resistance to psychic damage.

name: Emerald
description: Green fur. Resistance to poison damage.

name: Moss Agate
description: Frosted white crystal fur veined with dark-green moss agate. Resistance to acid damage.

name: Onyx
description: Black fur. Resistance to necrotic damage.

name: Opal
description: Pearly white fur, the classic Vellari look. Resistance to radiant damage.

name: Quartz
description: Clear crystal fur. Resistance to force damage.

name: Ruby
description: Red fur. Resistance to fire damage.

name: Sapphire
description: Blue fur. Resistance to cold damage.

name: Topaz
description: Orange fur. Resistance to lightning damage.
